title: "A shared link exposes its title and summary"
created: 2026-11-21T12:00:00Z
author: agent:fixture-editor
source: "Functional spec §§5, 8.4, 12"
status: provisional
tags: ["import","audience"]
---

For material that must stay gated, use import --link-only. A summary is optional. Put only shareable facts in its title, tags and summary; the remote system decides who can open the original. Ask about the audience when it is unclear.
